description: Hand-worked waterfall cases. See hand-worked.md for the arithmetic. Language-neutral: any engine (TS, Python) should reproduce these. Allocations are fund-level sums; tiers not listed are expected to be 0. Tolerance 1e-9 unless stated. metrics.accruedCarry (default 0) is the GP share of a hypothetical liquidation of the NAV; TVPI and IRR use NAV net of it. M3 cases add `fees` (management fee terms), partner roles/fee classes, and expected fees, lpFlows (LP investors' dated cash flows, summed per date) and bridge (gross profit -> fees -> carry -> net, all partners). M4 cases add terms.structure 'american' with lossRecovery, dealId on events, and expected.clawback {american, european, clawback}; totals are before clawback, lpFlows and DPI include the clawback paid to LPs at the end.
